preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= wi <= 50 for ui, vi, wi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and have a length between 1 and 50.
The starting vertex s must be a valid vertex number.
The number of criminals m must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xj <= n and xj != s for xj in criminals)
preconditions.description: Each criminal must be located at a valid vertex and not at the starting vertex s.

postconditions.description: If the policeman cannot catch all criminals, the output must be 'Terrorists win'.
If the policeman can catch all criminals, the output must be a non-negative integer representing the time needed.
